description: Publish the selected global/local inventory collision layers: accepted current CAD meshes, measured unknown-object OBBs and table cuboids. Reuse compatible resident GPU planners. This does not capture images, run SAM3 or FoundationPose, or integrate TSDF/ESDF in CAD/OBB mode. Global updates all currently observed inventory entities; local updates only the selected entities and preserves valid other layers. Neither means hidden space has been observed. The graph chooses scope and exclusion_state. observation keeps all obstacles for empty-hand viewpoint motion; selected binds the current grasp target. A selected map is not an observation map. Missing or stale required geometry is reported, never repaired by republishing identical data. With scope=local, empty entity_ids uses the currently selected target_id, including a selected product. Explicit local lists refresh their selected object layers. scope=decide requests a mapping strategy judgment when more than one scope is permitted. Required collision bodies come from current measurements, retained layers, action-invalidated bodies and the active target/destination. A historical inventory row without measured geometry does not independently require a collision layer. Missing or stale geometry for an active or affected body remains an explicit failure. The initial publication must be global. Local updates require collision_map_initialized=true from a successful complete global publication; geometry invalidation preserves this base, while reset clears it. With scope=decide before initialization, global is the sole permitted scope and requires no Decisions call. Explicit local requests are never changed to global.
